Fountain Finances LTD is a Claims Management Company (CMC).You
can claim for free without using a CMC, first to your finance partner or to the FOS. The FCA
is likely to introduce a free consumer redress scheme. We will pass your case to a
CMC/Solicitor who will pay us a referral fee.£1,846.23* is the average redress achieved by
our partner law firm. This figure is an average claim value per agreement of our partner law
firm HD Law, as of July 31st 2025.
